EM--46
ENGINE MECHANICAL -· CYLINDER HEAD
DISASSEMBLY
1. REMOVE OIL CONTROL VALVE for VVT
Remove the bolt and cam timing oi! control valve.
2. REMOVE OIL CONTROL VALVE FILTER
Remove the bolt, gasket and oil control valve filter.
N
3. 2ZZ--GE:
REMOVE OIL CONTROL VALVE HOUSING
(a) Remove the bolt and oil control valve for VVTL.
(b) Using SST, remove the oil pressure switch.
SST 098i6-30010
(c) Remove the 3 bolts, 2 nuts, oil control valve housing and
gasket.
(d) Remove the oil control valve filter.
N
4. 2ZZ-GE:
REMOVE VALVE ROCKER ARM
(a) Remove the 2 bolts, rocker No. 1 and No. 2 shafts.
(b) Remove the 8 valve rocker arm.
HINT:
Arrange the rocker arms in the correct order.
5. REMOVE VALVE LIFTERS
HINT:
N A!04'6 Arrange the valve lifters !n the correct order.
6. REMOVE VALVES
(a) Using SST, compress the valve spring and remove the 2
keepers,
SST 09202-70020 (09202-00020)
(b) Remove the spring retainer.
(c) Remove the valve spring.
(d) Remove the valve.
(e) Using needle-nose pliers, remove the oil seal.
A010.2
